description_en: Copies a custom image from the current region to a destination region
description_zh: 将当前地域的自定义镜像拷贝至目标地域
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone copy-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id cpm-xxxxxxxx --destination-region-id cn-beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyImage

parameters.help_en: The source region from which the image is copied
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom image to be copied
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The destination region to which the image is copied
parameters.name: destination_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the new cloud phone image
